summary.name: SiteSucker
summary.one_liner: SiteSucker is a Mac application that downloads entire websites to a local drive, duplicating the site's directory structure for offline browsing.
use_cases: Download a website for offline browsing
Make local backup copy of a site you have rights to
Save embedded videos from web pages (Pro version)
Archive website files and directory structure
summary.what_it_does: SiteSucker asynchronously copies a site's web pages, images, PDFs, style sheets and other files to the local disk, duplicating the site's directory structure. By default it localizes links so the site can be browsed offline, though it can also download without modification. Download settings can be saved to a document, and an in-progress download is paused and saved on save so it can be resumed later with the Resume button. SiteSucker Pro adds the ability to download embedded YouTube, Vimeo, WordPress and Wistia videos.
notable: Saves download state to a document and resumes later
Localizes links for offline browsing by default
SiteSucker Pro downloads embedded videos from YouTube, Vimeo, WordPress and Wistia
Universal app for Intel and Apple silicon; requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later
caveats: Should only be used to download files the user has the legitimate right to access
Pro trial is 14 days and limited to 100 files per download; Pro must be purchased after that
Current version requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later; older macOS versions need older SiteSucker releases
